# Version 4.152.0
> **Graphite and m152** · Released September 5, 2026 · [NuGet](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.152.0) · [GitHub Release](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/releases/tag/v4.152.0)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.200/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU bindings and asynchronous pixel readback on the Skia m152 engine. This release adds new GPU and pixel-access capabilities, strengthens native lifetime safety, and broadens package and platform support.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this release.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated through Chrome m152 servicing** — Moves the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone 152 and incorporates subsequent upstream stability and servicing fixes. ([#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537), [#4538](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4538), [#4568](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4568), [#4651](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4651), [#4808](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4808), [#4925](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4925))

## API Surface

- **Graphite GPU backend bindings added** — Adds managed bindings for Skia's Graphite backend on Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn. — ❤️ [@ramezgerges](https://github.com/ramezgerges) ([#3968](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/3968))
- **Asynchronous pixel readback added** — SKImage and SKSurface can now request pixel readback asynchronously through a backend-neutral API. ([#4545](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4545))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native-backed pixel and region objects remain valid** — Roots pixel sources and regions while native operations use them, preventing use-after-free failures in subset, With*, and span-iteration operations. ([#4355](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4355), [#4558](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4558))
- **Raster image creation and uniform resets release resources correctly** — Fixes a pixel-buffer allocation leak after raster creation failure and disposes the previous runtime-effect uniform buffer on reset. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455), [#4783](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4783))

## Platform

- **Vulkan and Apple package support expanded** — Adds the Vulkan Silk.NET package and Apple native symbol packages, with corresponding production packaging support. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527), [#4841](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4841), [#4846](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4846))
- **Nano Server font support improved** — Uses FreeType to provide font support on Nano Server. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.2.1.200

HarfBuzz shaping avoids an unnecessary feature-array copy, and non-memory-backed streams are released correctly when converted to blobs.
